exposure: theory of planned behavior constructs (attitude, subjective norms, perceived behavioral control)
cohort: The study included 353 pregnant women aged 15-45 years referred to four selected hospitals in Rasht, northern Iran in 2020.
finding: The theory of planned behavior constructs, particularly attitude, along with social support and participation in childbirth education classes, were strong predictors of natural childbirth intention among pregnant women.
mod_finding: The study found that the attitude construct was the best predictor of natural childbirth intention, indicating a significant influence on the choice of birth mode.
gest_age: Most participants were in the third trimester of pregnancy (37.7%) at the time of the study.
